forge_keep_suffixes:Name: Suffix Ward
forge_keep_suffixes:Text: The suffixes stay; every prefix rolls anew
forge_keep_suffixes:Line: Hold the back. Pour the front again.
forge_keep_suffixes:FoundIn: Edda teaches it at Forge level 4
forge_temper:Name: Oathsteel Temper
forge_temper:Text: The crafted modifier rises one tier (never to the best: drops stay the chase)
forge_all_res:Name: Oathward
forge_all_res:Text: Adds crafted resistance to all elements to a ring or amulet (a suffix)
forge_crit_multi:Name: Deathblow
forge_crit_multi:Text: Adds a crafted critical strike multiplier to a weapon or amulet (a suffix)
forge_crit_multi:Line: When it lands, make it count.
forge_area:Name: Widening Glyph
forge_area:Text: Adds crafted area of effect to a helm or amulet (a suffix)
forge_area:Line: Wider. Let them all feel it.
forge_bow_gems:Name: Fletcher's Oath
forge_bow_gems:Text: Adds a crafted +1 to Level of all Skill Gems to a bow (a prefix)
forge_bow_gems:Line: A bowyer's oath: the string remembers every shot.
forge_unique:Name: Vowkeeper's Blessing
forge_unique:Text: A unique's values re-roll inside their ranges
forge_unique:Line: Even a legend can be struck again.
forge_hone:Name: Whetstone
forge_hone:Text: Re-rolls the value of ONE chosen mod, inside its own tier
forge_hone:Line: Pick the one that bothers you. I'll grind it again.
forge_recast:Name: Recast
forge_recast:Text: Melts ONE chosen mod out; a new one of the same kind (prefix or suffix) pours in
forge_recast:Line: Out with the bad line. The mould remembers its shape.
forge_recast:FoundIn: Edda teaches it at Forge level 2
forge_quench:Name: Deep Quench
forge_quench:Text: Every mod rolls a new tier and value the item level allows (a crafted mod stays)
forge_quench:Line: Quench it deep. It comes out better, or it doesn't.
forge_quench:FoundIn: Edda teaches it at Forge level 3
forge_chisel:Name: Chisel
forge_chisel:Text: Chisels ONE chosen mod off; its slot opens for a crafted one
forge_chisel:Line: Show me the line you hate. I'll cut it clean.
forge_anneal:Name: Anneal
forge_anneal:Text: ONE chosen mod goes a tier better (never the best tier: drops keep that)
forge_anneal:Line: Heat, patience, a lighter hammer. It comes back stronger.
forge_anneal:FoundIn: Edda teaches it at Forge level 2
forge_echo_add:Name: Add
forge_echo_add:Text: A chosen mod joins an open slot at the lowest tier, paid with one of its Echoes
forge_echo_add:Line: Pick the line you want. The Echo knows the way in.
forge_echo_temper:Name: Temper up
forge_echo_temper:Text: ONE chosen mod goes a tier better, paid with one of its Echoes
forge_echo_temper:Line: Feed it its own echo. It remembers being stronger.
forge_echo_reroll:Name: Reroll value
forge_echo_reroll:Text: ONE chosen mod's value rolls again inside its tier
forge_echo_reroll:Line: One more pass of the grinder.
forge_echo_remove:Name: Remove
forge_echo_remove:Text: ONE chosen mod comes off; its slot opens
forge_echo_remove:Line: Cut it out clean. The slot is yours again.
forge_socket:Name: Socket
forge_socket:Text: Bores one jewel socket into a magic or rare weapon, body armour, helmet or shield (magic up to 2, rare 1)
forge_socket:Line: Hold still. A good hole is a kind of promise.
forge_sky_temper:Name: Skyforged Temper
forge_sky_temper:Text: The crafted modifier rises one tier, even to the best tier
forge_sky_temper:Line: Core fire. Hotter than anything I own. Hold it steady.
forge_sky_temper:FoundIn: Learnt with your first Core Ember (a Core Rupture's Lord)
forge_sky_anneal:Name: Skyforged Anneal
forge_sky_anneal:Text: ONE chosen mod goes a tier better, even to the best tier
forge_sky_anneal:Line: This is the heat the old smiths dreamt of. One line. Make it count.
forge_sky_anneal:FoundIn: Learnt with your first Core Ember (a Core Rupture's Lord)
forge_hone_glyph:Name: Hone
forge_hone_glyph:Text: Quality +1% (to 10%): more of the item's own defences or physical damage
forge_hone_glyph:Line: Long strokes. Let the stone do the work.
forge_hone_steel:Name: Oathsteel Hone
forge_hone_steel:Line: Past ten, only oathsteel bites. Slower now.
forge_hone_ember:Name: Skyforged Hone
forge_hone_ember:Text: Quality +1% past 20%: 3 Core Embers, three times more for each point after
forge_hone_ember:Line: Nobody hones past twenty. Nobody but us.
forge_hone_ember:FoundIn: Learnt with your first Core Ember (a Core Rupture's Lord)
forge_quality81_whet:Name: Ember Whetstone
forge_quality81_whet:Text: Weapon Quality: +5% on a white, +2% magic, +1% rare or unique, up to 20%
forge_quality81_whet:Line: Draw it toward you. Let the edge drink the ember.
forge_quality81_rivet:Name: Ember Rivet
forge_quality81_rivet:Text: Armour Quality: +5% on a white, +2% magic, +1% rare or unique, up to 20%
forge_quality81_rivet:Line: One hot rivet, one clean strike.
forge_gloom_anneal:Name: Lightless Anneal
forge_gloom_anneal:Text: ONE chosen mod goes a tier better (never the best tier), paid in Gloomsilver from the Catacomb depths
forge_gloom_anneal:Line: Grown in the dark. It makes good steel a little better.
forge_gloom_gems:Name: Gloomsight
forge_gloom_gems:Text: Adds a crafted +1 to Level of all Skill Gems to an amulet, a helm, a tome, a wand, a staff or a melee weapon (a prefix), paid in Gloomsilver
forge_gloom_gems:Line: What you learn in the dark, you keep.
forge_gloom_rot:Name: Black Below Rot
forge_gloom_rot:Text: Adds a crafted damage over time multiplier to a weapon, amulet, quiver or tome (a prefix), paid in Gloomsilver
forge_gloom_rot:Line: Down there everything rots a little faster.
forge_gloom_ward:Name: Abyssal Ward
forge_gloom_ward:Text: Adds crafted physical damage taken as elemental to a chest, shield or helm (a suffix), paid in Gloomsilver
forge_gloom_ward:Line: The deep turns a blow into cold fire.
forge_gloom_wick:Name: Lampwick
forge_gloom_wick:Text: Adds crafted cooldown recovery to an amulet or a weapon (a suffix), paid in Gloomsilver
forge_gloom_wick:Line: Trim the wick, light it again.
